notes.title: Micro world
notes.notes:
New ride available now, download free update to try Micro-World.
Watch nature from the perspective of the bug.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37648914/2393161936778b2031ebf983d5da7e09f4668310.jpg[/img]

In next update i plan to:
- smooth the rides tracks. 
- add some more animations to the dinosaurs in dino ride,
- fix bow issue with knuckles controllers,
- I started motion platforms support, i plan to add it soon,
- Two more rides will be added as seprate updates.

If you have any suggestions or ideas, please post it here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1070690/discussions/0/2248931052737080493/?ctp=2

Thank you for your support! You are breathtaking :D

notes.title: Skyscraper City Coaster
notes.notes:
New ride has been added to the experience - Skyscraper City Coaster, available now as a free update. That's 6th Roller Coaster in the app, hope it will be fun for you :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37648914/832fbea4cca94d3c5d14ac6d6523df36950c732b.gif[/img]

If you have any idea for next, new ride, please post it right here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1070690/discussions/0/2248931052737080493/

Soon i will add motion platforms support - perfect for VR Arcades and users that have this hardware in home. It will increase immersion greatly, I hope so.

PS. Im thinking about adding some different experiences to the app, not-roller Coasters. If you think its interesting idea, please let me know here: 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1070690/discussions/0/2248931052741775515/

Something like "The Lab" mini games. Could be fun ^^
